title: Normalized graph (adapter output)
description: What a per-tracker producer ADAPTER emits: a tracker-neutral, already-role-mapped snapshot (`sync`) or change set (`delta`). This is the ONLY tracker-specific step; all graph reasoning is done downstream by `scripts/derive`, which consumes exactly this shape. An adapter MUST map its tracker's substates to §2.3 roles/groups and MUST NOT compute blocking, ranking, or derived sections.

kind.description: `sync` = the complete document for the selected projects (replaces the cache). `delta` = only what changed since `cursor` (upsert nodes/milestones/projects; `removed` deletes). Incremental delta is the steady state; sync is first-run/recovery/cursor-gap fallback.

source.description: Opaque per-source id identifying the tracker + selected project set. Stable across ticks so the orchestrator can key its cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque tracker-defined cursor (Linear updatedAt, Jira updated, GitHub since). The orchestrator persists it and passes it back to request the next delta; it never interprets it.

order.description: Sequence within the project (0-based). derive uses it to gate later milestones on earlier ones' review (§2.3). Adapters MUST supply a total order per project.

ready_for_review.description: Tracker signal that the milestone is ready for its §2.3 review. derive FORCES this false when the milestone still has unresolved work (stale-review guard), so an adapter may pass the raw tracker signal without pre-checking completeness.

review_recorded.description: Whether the current ready-for-review episode's review has been recorded. derive forces it false whenever ready_for_review is false, so a stale record can never suppress §2.3 re-review.

role.description: §2.3 role (adapter maps its substate -> role). Only `verified` and `canceled` clear a dependency; `awaiting-external`/`paused` mark a park.

target_kind.description: What working the ticket entails. `human-only` is never dispatched to a coordinator.

human_interactive.description: True when the configured tracker signal (a label/field) marks the ticket for a human (§2.6). Such nodes are surfaced as human-blocked and never dispatched.

terminated_without_verify.description: Tracker-dependent classification: the ticket reached a dead terminal that is NOT `verified` and NOT `canceled` and will not progress (e.g. failed/abandoned-and-parked). derive uses it to classify permanently-blocked dependents. A `canceled` ticket MUST NOT set this (cancellation unblocks).

labels.description: Consumed by the orchestrator ONLY as the source of the human_interactive signal; never to reason over ticket content.

branch_seed.description: Non-authoritative dispatch hint forwarded to the coordinator.

blocked_by.description: Ids this node directly depends on (§2.3 dependency edges). Same-tracker cross-project edges are allowed and surfaced as anomalies; cross-tracker edges are illegal (§2.3).

removed.description: delta only: node/milestone/project ids removed since the cursor.
